{"consolidated_memory":"## Intermittent EOF in crypto/tls/handshake.go — Three Separate Incidents

All work in crypto/tls/handshake.go, security side. Same corner of codebase across all three occasions, so context carried over. Symptom in all cases: unexpected end of stream during negotiation. Repro pattern consistent across all: open many short-lived connections in a row.

### Incident 1: [2026-02-26]
**Trigger:** Tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
**Root cause:** Config loader reading the wrong environment file
**Measured outcome:** Memory settled at 320 MB instead of climbing past 2 GB
**Fix:** Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
**PR #1779, branch fix/intermittent-eof-1**

### Incident 2: [2026-05-07]
**Trigger:** Payloads above roughly two megabytes
**Root cause:** Serialiser dropping fields it did not know
**Measured outcome:** Error rate dropped from 7.9 percent to under 5 per ten thousand
**Fix:** Switched to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields
**PR #8024, branch fix/intermittent-eof-2**

### Incident 3: [2026-07-19]
**Trigger:** Traffic arriving through the corporate proxy
**Root cause:** Schema drift between the migration and the model
**Measured outcome:** Backlog cleared 76 minutes after the deploy
**Fix:** Regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum
**PR #9076, branch fix/intermittent-eof-3**"}
